four_piece.name: Warrior Goddess of Sun and Thunder

relic_sets.notes: GUESS. The only hint is scoring.presets: WARRIOR_SET (FuXuan.ts:302-304), which turns the Warrior Goddess set conditional on in the optimizer form. That is a set effect the optimizer assumes, not a recommendation, and its 4-piece needs the wearer or memosprite to heal another ally, which her kit text should be checked for. Warrior Goddess 4-piece chosen anyway; its 2-piece gives +6% SPD, which sets her SPD below.

ornament_set.name: Broken Keel
ornament_set.notes: GUESS. Broken Keel (+10% Effect RES; at 30% Effect RES or more, all allies +10% CRIT DMG). Her trace gives 10% RES, the set 10%, and the 2 fixed rolls 7.8%, so 27.8% before any distributed RES; 2 distributed RES rolls reach 35.6%. Sunday's file also picks Broken Keel; whether two wearers stack is for the kernel adapter to decide, not this file.

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options (FuXuan.ts:282-301): Body HP%/DEF%, Feet HP%/DEF%/SPD, Sphere HP%/DEF%, Rope HP%/DEF%/Energy Regeneration Rate. GUESS: HP% on the three non-Feet slots (HP% has the highest weight, 1, with DEF% at 0.75) and SPD boots. Rope Energy Regeneration Rate is the alternative and affects Ultimate timing; Smitty should decide it.

spd_target.reason: Turn breakpoint: 20000/150 = 133.33 SPD, so 133.34 gives 2 turns in the first 150 AV cycle (src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1). No Fribbels SPD target (weights only, FuXuan.ts:268-281); already met.

distributed.notes: All GUESS, from the scoring weights (FuXuan.ts:268-281): HP% 1, HP 1, DEF% 0.75, DEF 0.75, RES 0.5, SPD 1. Caps: HP% 6 (three HP% main stats), HP 10, DEF% 12. HP% is filled to its cap of 6, HP 6, DEF% 10, RES 2 (for Broken Keel's 30%). SPD: target 133.34 (K14e, turn breakpoint). 100 base + 6 (Warrior Goddess 2-piece, 6% of base) + 25.032 + 4.6 = 135.632 with 0 distributed rolls (margin 2.292). Changed from the earlier draft: no change to the split. Priority by the file's counts then weights (HP% 1, HP 1, DEF% 0.75, DEF 0.75, RES 0.5): DEF% 10, HP% 6, HP 6 (tie, list order), Effect RES 2, then DEF (0 rolls). GUESS: this puts DEF% ahead of HP% only because the file gave DEF% the most rolls (HP% is capped at 6); the weights would put HP% first. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs.
